ImageDrop.Hint.zh:
切到资源管理器，将图片文件拖到这里。
支持 PNG、JPEG、BMP、WebP。
ImageDrop.Hint.en:
Switch to File Explorer and drag image files here.
PNG, JPEG, BMP and WebP are supported.

ImageDrop.Waiting.zh: 关闭后保持穿透；点击“返回原画布编辑”可继续编辑原画布。
ImageDrop.Waiting.en: Closing keeps pass-through active. Choose Return to original editor to resume your canvas.

ImageDrop.Busy.zh: 正在导入…关闭此窗口可取消。
ImageDrop.Busy.en: Importing… Close this window to cancel.

ImageDrop.Imported.zh: 已导入 {0} 张图片。关闭后可继续操作电脑。
ImageDrop.Imported.en: Imported {0} image(s). Close this window to keep using your desktop.

ImageDrop.Unsupported.zh: 请拖入 PNG、JPEG、BMP 或 WebP 图片文件。
ImageDrop.Unsupported.en: Drag PNG, JPEG, BMP or WebP image files here.

ImageDrop.Failed.zh:
导入失败：{0}
可以重新拖入图片。
ImageDrop.Failed.en:
Import failed: {0}
You can drag the images in again.

ImageDrop.TargetChanged.zh: 原画布已关闭或更换，请关闭此窗口后重新开始拖入。
ImageDrop.TargetChanged.en: The original canvas was closed or replaced. Close this window and start a new import.
